purpose: Targeted compact-layout and bidirectional-G0 retest for the last two final combinational IC circuits.
shared_rules: 74HC7266 in the prompt is normalized to the accepted Proteus donor family 74HC266.
Pin 14 and pin 7 supply instructions are accepted as user metadata but not emitted for IC packages.
R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. G0 passive endpoints are converted to $TERBIDIR instead of emitting $TERGROUND.
Small IC/passive cases use a compact nearby passive column so the last-two layouts are not spread across the sheet.
Circuit 30 does not emit a MOSFET because no MOSFET donor has been accepted yet.

cases.title: NOR Power-On Reset driving AND Enable
cases.description: V0 charges timing node through R/C; NOR output enables data through AND.
cases.hidden_supply_policy: Pin 14 and pin 7 are user-input-only metadata for 74HCxx gates; no explicit IC supply pins are emitted.
cases.terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Passive G0 uses same-name $TERBIDIR; an IC pin tied to ground would use a same-name $TERINPUT(G0), not a bidirectional IC terminal.
cases.layout_policy: Compact last-two V2: IC package spacing is 3,810,000 and nearby passive columns start at x=8,890,000.
